WHAT DO THE 3 RPCI SCREENERS HELP US
UNDERSTAND?
(1) First scanner helps you find stocks that have been consolidating
for a long time, e.g., 3–5 months or more.
(2) Second scanner helps you find stocks that have been consolidating
for 2–3 weeks or more.
(3) Third scanner helps you find recently listed IPOs that are
consolidating.
